lines.text: Eighty-four percent of developers now use, or plan to use, AI tools to write code.
In 2023, that number was forty-four. The people who build software adopted first, and fastest.
And here is the number nobody puts on the poster: forty-six percent of them do not trust what it writes. Only thirty-three percent do.
So they check everything by hand the tool arrives with no memory of their project, no instructions of theirs, no checks of their own.
The builders adopted the model. Almost none of them own the layer that would make it trustworthy.
Adoption counted, ownership taught one short at a time. Follow the channel.
